title: Growth-like multi-group scenario: research, content and listing work for one product

units.description: A blog post, X thread or other public-facing draft a human could review for publication
units.evidence: reviewer acceptance under the rubric, with every checkable claim verified against the repository archive

units.description: A research note, report, ledger or verified-facts sheet that supports the growth plan
units.evidence: every repo-derived count and version reproducible from a command against the repository archive

units.description: A listing submission packet or outreach draft ready to use without rework
units.evidence: reviewer acceptance under the rubric; the packet names its target and every claim in it is verifiable

completion_rule: All three units present and accepted. An artifact split into several files, or an easy note standing in for a required unit, adds nothing.

criteria.description: Matches the voice and rules in the workspace's brand and plan files, including claims the plan says never to make
Every checkable claim about the product can be verified in the repository archive or is explicitly marked unverified
Adds something beyond what the original workspace already contained
Specific enough that a human can use it or act on it next without redoing the work

critical_failures: a false or fabricated claim about the product, its counts, versions or features
a claim of work done that the produced files do not contain
a statement or action that would publish content without review

allowed_recovery: automatic restart of a crashed role within the runtime's retry limits
one operator answer to a blocking question, recorded as an intervention

primary_comparisons: cost per accepted unit, candidate vs matched baseline, paired by run
probability of a fully accepted fixture, with its Wilson interval
false or fabricated claims per run
